title: Grateful Dead Live at McNichols Sports Arena on 1977-10-09
lineage: Soundboard Reels (Akai GX-636)> Lamb Labs dolby decoder > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp 2496> Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Sandy Troy's 7" Soundboard Reels @ 3.75 ips of unknown provenance (reels were not labeled, except to denote the date & dolby b)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a Fall ’77 show with blazing Fire on the Mountain and soaring Terrapin Station
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the dramatically improved sound quality, calling it “eons better” than other sources, and praises the performance—Fire earns its name and Terrapin builds from angelic to majestic. Both the recording and the musical delivery are described as top‑notch with no complaints.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights a stellar performance (Fire, Terrapin) and an excellent soundboard recording; the limited sample size lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound described as dramatically clearer than other downloads; no issues noted, crisp and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong Fall ’77 vibe; the set builds nicely with highlighted peaks at Fire and Terrapin.
